info.title: Cerner (Oracle Health) FHIR R4 API
info.description: HL7 FHIR R4 REST API for the Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium Platform. Provides access to clinical, administrative, financial, and scheduling healthcare data through standardized FHIR R4 resources. Supports SMART on FHIR OAuth 2.0 authorization.

smartOnFhir.description: SMART on FHIR OAuth 2.0 authorization. Supports authorization code flow with PKCE for EHR launch and standalone launch scenarios. Scopes follow the pattern {context}/{resource}.{permissions} where context is patient, user, or system.

scopes.openid: Permission to retrieve OpenID Connect ID token
scopes.fhirUser: Permission to retrieve FHIR user claim
scopes.online_access: Request online access (refresh token valid during session)
